properties.description:
Data Quality gate pipeline — runs DQ validation notebook after every load.

                   Flow:
                   1. Run DQ validation notebook (dq_validation.py)
                   2. Read DQ results from Delta table (omnioc_dev.bronze.dq_validation_results)
                   3. IfCondition: any CRITICAL failures? → fail pipeline + alert
                   4. If no CRITICAL: check HIGH severity count → warn but continue
                   5. Write DQ run summary to pipeline log variable

                   This is the quality gate between ingestion and Gold model building.
                   The master pipeline will NOT proceed to Gold if this fails.

                   DQ results stored in: omnioc_dev.bronze.dq_validation_results
                   Alerting: calls PL_07_Alerting with DQ failure details.

activities.name: Run DQ Validation Notebook
activities.description:
Execute DQ validation across all Bronze and Silver tables.
                              Notebook raises AssertionError if CRITICAL checks fail — ADF catches this.

activities.name: Read DQ Result Summary
activities.description: Lookup latest DQ run results — count critical failures from Delta table.

activities.name: DQ Passed — Set Status
activities.description: DQ validation passed — record success in pipeline variable.

activities.name: DQ Failed — Raise Alert
activities.description: If DQ notebook threw error (CRITICAL checks failed), trigger alerting pipeline.

parameters.failure_reason: CRITICAL DQ checks failed — Gold model build blocked

activities.name: DQ Failed — Propagate Failure
activities.description: Re-raise failure so master pipeline knows DQ gate failed.

message.value: @concat('DQ Gate FAILED for run_id: ', pipeline().parameters.run_id, '. Check omnioc_dev.bronze.dq_validation_results for details.')
